==================
Single-line Function lambda
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim square = Function(x) x * x
    End Sub
End Module

              (identifier))))))))

==================
Single-line Sub lambda
==================

Module M

        Dim printer = Sub(msg) Console.WriteLine(msg)
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Lambda with typed parameters
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim add = Function(a As Integer, b As Integer) a + b
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Lambda with no parameters
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim now = Function() DateTime.Now
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Multi-line Function lambda
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim classify = Function(n As Integer)
                           If n > 0 Then
                               Return "pos"
                           Else
                               Return "neg"
                           End If
                       End Function
    End Sub
End Module

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (module_block
      (identifier)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (dim_statement
          (identifier)
          (lambda_expression
            (lambda_parameter
              (identifier)
              (as_clause
                (primitive_type)))
            (if_statement
              (binary_expression
                (identifier)
                (integer_literal))
              (return_statement
                (string_literal))
              (else_clause
                (return_statement
                  (string_literal))))))))))

==================
Multi-line Sub lambda
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Dim logger = Sub(msg As String)
                         Console.WriteLine(msg)
                         Count += 1
                     End Sub
    End Sub
End Module

                (identifier))
              (integer_literal))))))))
